result.instructions: Tools for PestScan, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which locations had new infestations recorded this month?"; "List the orders completed in the last 7 days."; "Show the bait station records for location 1234.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PestScan data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run pestscan_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pestscan_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pestscan_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. pestscan_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pestscan_test_connection
tools.title: Test connection
tools.description: Log in and check that the PestScan API answers. Good first call. PestScan API: GET /v1/test/connection.

tools.name: pestscan_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (companies and private persons) with their names and external ids. Use it to find a customer id. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/customers.

searchText.description: Free-text search filter, as the API accepts it.

externalId.description: Filter by the external id your system uses for the record.

id.description: Filter by the numeric PestScan id.

tools.name: pestscan_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List customer locations (the sites that pests are checked at), with their customer id. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/locations.

searchText.description: Free-text search filter, as the API accepts it.

externalId.description: Filter by the external id your system uses for the record.

id.description: Filter by the numeric PestScan id.

tools.name: pestscan_get_location
tools.title: Get location
tools.description: Get one location with its full details by PestScan id. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/locations/GetById?id.

id.description: The numeric PestScan id of the record.

tools.name: pestscan_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders (visits) created in a date range, with status, visit type and planned dates. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/orders.

fromDate.description: Only orders created on or after this date or date-time.

toDate.description: Only orders created on or before this date or date-time.

id.description: Filter by the numeric PestScan id.

externalId.description: Filter by the external id your system uses for the record.

tools.name: pestscan_list_new_orders
tools.title: List new orders
tools.description: List order sheets that are new for this integration, not yet taken over. Reading does not confirm them. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/orders/new.

tools.name: pestscan_list_completed_orders
tools.title: List completed orders
tools.description: List order sheets that are completed and ready for the integration. Reading does not confirm them. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/orders/completed.

tools.name: pestscan_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments with their employees, in a date range (end on or after fromDate, start on or before toDate). PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/appointments.

id.description: Filter by the numeric PestScan id.

tools.name: pestscan_list_infestations
tools.title: List infestations
tools.description: List infestations (pest findings) recorded at a location, filtered by survey, bait station, pest type or date. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/infestations.

surveyId.description: Filter by the location (survey) PestScan id.

externalSurveyId.description: Filter by the location (survey) external id.

baitStationId.description: Filter by the bait station id.

pestType.description: Filter by pest type, as the API names it.

tools.name: pestscan_list_bait_stations
tools.title: List bait stations
tools.description: List bait stations (monitoring points) with their location, optionally from a date. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/baitstations.

baitStationId.description: Filter by the numeric PestScan id.

surveyId.description: Filter by the location (survey) PestScan id.

externalSurveyId.description: Filter by the location (survey) external id.

getFrom.description: Only bait stations changed on or after this date or date-time.

tools.name: pestscan_list_recommendations
tools.title: List recommendations
tools.description: List recommendations (advice from the inspector) for locations, filtered by survey and status. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/recommendations.

status.description: Filter by the exact recommendation status value.

getFrom.description: Only recommendations changed on or after this date or date-time.

tools.name: pestscan_list_consumption
tools.title: List material consumption
tools.description: List materials used (consumption) per location or visit, in a date range. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/consumption.

surveyId.description: Filter by the location (survey) PestScan id.

surveyExternalId.description: Filter by the location (survey) external id.

orderSheetId.description: Filter by the visit (order sheet) PestScan id.

tools.name: pestscan_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees (technicians and office users) with their names and external ids. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/employees.

searchText.description: Search by first name, last name or username.

externalId.description: Filter by the external id your system uses for the record.

employeeId.description: Filter by the numeric PestScan id.

tools.name: pestscan_list_articles
tools.title: List articles
tools.description: List articles (products and materials) with their category. Category 0 = rodents, 1 = insects, 2 = electric traps. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/articles.

externalId.description: Filter by the external id your system uses for the record.

id.description: Filter by the numeric PestScan id.

categoryId.description: Filter by category id (0 = rodents, 1 = insects, 2 = electric traps).

tools.name: pestscan_list_visit_types
tools.title: List visit types
tools.description: List the visit types (kinds of visit) that the account uses. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/visit-types.

id.description: Filter by the numeric PestScan id.
